cohort: 37,734 women with singleton pregnancies were classified into euthyroid and isolated maternal hypothyroxinemia groups based on thyroid function test results obtained during early pregnancy (gestational weeks 11-13).
finding: Early pregnancy isolated maternal hypothyroxinemia (IMH) is associated with increased risks of several adverse pregnancy outcomes, with persistent IMH related to a broader spectrum of adverse events, and these risks may vary by maternal age and pre-pregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: IMH was associated with an increased incidence of emergency cesarean section, with a linear increase observed across euthyroid, transient IMH, and persistent IMH groups.
